topic: Myth or fact about Grand Theft Auto VI: what people believe about the game scheduled for 19 November 2026
title: GTA VI Myth or Fact: What You Got Wrong #siliconverdict #gta6 #gaming
description: We test the beliefs people repeat about Grand Theft Auto VI against what Rockstar and its release plans actually say. Discs, AI NPCs, weapons, the map and more.
pinned_comment: Disc myth or weapon limit? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Some of what you believe about GTA VI is already wrong.
Let's test the beliefs, and the last one catches most people out.
First belief: the box holds a disc. Actually it holds a download code.
Rockstar swapped discs for codes to stop leaks, and you can preload early.
Next belief: the crowds are AI generated. Rockstar says they are handcrafted instead.
No procedural generation. Every NPC is handcrafted, with traits shaped by district and behavior.
Third belief: the old unlimited weapon inventory returns. It does not, there are strict limits now.
You carry two primary firearms and two sidearms. The rest stays in your vehicle.
items: The rest stays in your car

scenes.text: The map is three times bigger
scenes.narration: Fourth belief: the map is three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2. Reported, not confirmed.
Reports say roughly three times the playable area of Red Dead Redemption 2.
Fifth belief: no microtransactions at launch. That one is true, Rockstar confirmed it.
Those are three confirmed points, straight from Rockstar.

scenes.text: Xbox One can't play it at all
scenes.narration: Here is the catch from earlier: Xbox One can play it, but only via Xbox Cloud Gaming.
Most people never check the source, so check before you share the next myth.
Follow for more tech. Which shocked you more, the disc myth or the weapon limit?
